# Using the wrong sequences means zero feature counts and failed demultiplexing.
# Columns:
#   id            unique identifier; must match hashtag_id in config/samples.tsv
#   name          display name shown in Cell Ranger output and Loupe
#   read          which read the barcode is on (R2 for TotalSeq-C)
#   pattern       where in the read the barcode sits; 5PNNNNNNNNNN(BC) is the
#                 standard TotalSeq-C pattern (10 bases of handle
#                 barcode). Check your vendor docs if using another chemistry.
#   sequence      the barcode nucleotide sequence
#   feature_type  "Antibody Capture" for both hashtags and surface proteins
